correctness.rationale: Direct third-edge exclusion forces each chosen component to be a single row edge, a single column edge, or a perpendicular two-edge elbow: rook neighborhoods are unions of row and column cliques and distinct components cannot reuse rows or columns. The bijection is reversible. Labeled disjoint-tile counting yields the exact factorial-weight polynomial and EGF. Row and column occupancy imply the sharp extremal bound and parity exception; equality cases exhaust the reported optimizer counts. Independent graph-compatibility enumeration verifies all coefficients for 13 boards (46,476 valid edge subsets), and separate symbolic arithmetic confirms top coefficients for 190 parameter pairs. The all-parameter proof is combinatorial; the finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Edge-open packings are natural color classes in injective edge coloring, so their complete size-distribution on L(K_{m,n}) is intrinsically motivated. The three-tile classification is structurally informative and proves a bivariate exponential generating function. The maximum’s odd-square defect and explicit optimizer counts are exact, infinite two-parameter extremal refinements rather than isolated low-order evaluations. No downstream theorem or broader classification is claimed without proof.
